question: Priya had 211 friendship pins on her backpack, while her friend Wren had 90 pins on hers. Priya traded away 170 pins at a pin-collecting meetup. Her remaining pins then tripled when a pin club offered a matching trade, a trade that took '60 minutes, or one hour' to complete. She then split her pins evenly into 3 pouches and kept only one pouch. She gave away 15 more pins from that pouch to a friend. Finally, she gave half of what was left to her sister. How many pins did Priya have after giving half to her sister?

A bakery had 76 loaves of bread ready for a farmers market. A bulk order turned every loaf into 8 loaves, and a second bulk order turned each of those into 3 loaves, a batch that took '120 minutes, or two hours' to bake. The baker mentioned that 20 extra bread bags were also bought, though that had nothing to do with the loaf count. The loaves were then split evenly into 6 delivery vans, and only one van's load was tracked for the market. A final farmers market order turned every loaf in that van into 6 loaves, and a last-minute rush order then turned every loaf into 8 loaves. How many loaves were in that van after the last-minute rush order?

A honey farm had 101 jars of honey ready at the start of harvest. A bumper crop turned every jar into 9 jars. A second bumper crop turned each of those into 5 jars, a harvest that took '600 minutes, or ten hours' to bottle. A large wholesale order then took away 884 jars. A final matching order turned every remaining jar into 2 jars. How many jars of honey were left after the final matching order?

Mia had 19 charm bracelets in a display case, while her friend Nadia had 12 charms of her own. A craft fair trade turned every charm Mia had into 3 charms. A second trade turned each of those into 2 charms, a swap that took '60 minutes, or one hour' to finish. She then lost 53 charms when a display case broke. A final trade turned every remaining charm into 4 charms. A bonus round turned each of those into 4 more charms. How many charms did Mia have after the bonus round?

A cookie shop had 24 trays of cookies ready for a bake sale. A bulk order turned every tray into 6 trays. The shop owner mentioned that 40 extra napkins were also ordered, though that had nothing to do with the tray count. A large catering order then took away 115 trays, and a smaller order took 12 more. A final wholesale order turned every remaining tray into 8 trays. A last donation added 54 more trays. How many trays of cookies were there after the last donation?

In the morning, Isaac had 106 seashells in his bucket, while his friend Talia had 60 shells in hers. By midday, he found 26 more shells along the shore, and in the afternoon a shell-multiplying trade turned every shell into 7 shells. The lifeguard mentioned that 15 beach umbrellas were also set up that day, though that had nothing to do with the shell count. That evening, 264 shells were donated to a school art project. Right after, he found 47 more shells during a low tide, and before heading home, he found 42 more shells near the pier. How many shells did Isaac have after finding the shells near the pier?

A comic shop had 181 comic books on the new-release wall. A customer returned 24 comics that were damaged in shipping, and a publisher replaced them with 24 fresh copies. The shop owner mentioned a dozen new comic bins had also arrived, though that had nothing to do with the comic count. A big sale then moved 173 comics off the wall. A restock event turned every remaining comic into 9 comics. A local creator donated 38 more comics for a signing event, but 18 comics were then sold to a collector. How many comics were on the wall after the sale to the collector?

A toy store had 59 puzzle boxes in stock at the start of the month. A restocking order turned every box into 2 boxes. The manager mentioned that 20 extra puzzle mats were also delivered, though that had nothing to do with the box count. A weekend sale then sold 33 boxes, and a wholesale order turned every remaining box into 4 boxes, a delivery that took '60 minutes, or one hour' to unload. The boxes were then split evenly between 2 storerooms, and only one storeroom's stock was tracked. A final donation added 11 more boxes to that storeroom. How many puzzle boxes were in that storeroom after the donation?

A bookstore had 203 novels in a special boxed-set display. A wholesale order turned every novel into 8 novels, and a second wholesale order turned each of those into 2 novels, a rollout that took '120 minutes, or two hours' to shelve. The store manager mentioned that 30 extra bookmarks were also delivered, though that had nothing to do with the novel count. A donation then added 80 more novels. The novels were then split evenly between 2 store branches, and only the downtown branch's stock was tracked. A final shipment added 51 more novels to the downtown branch. How many novels were at the downtown branch after the final shipment?

Lucas had 234 baseball cards in his binder, while his friend Theo had 100 cards in his. Lucas found 32 more cards in an old box, then lost 1 card that got damaged. His uncle mentioned a dozen new binders were also bought, though that had nothing to do with the card count. A trading event turned every card into 4 cards. He then traded away 771 cards for a single rare card he wanted. A final gift added 53 more cards. How many cards did Lucas have after receiving the final gift?

Amara had 209 seashells in her collection, while her friend Dax had 100 shells in his. A shell-multiplying trade turned every shell Amara had into 8 shells. She then found 60 more shells during a beach cleanup. A second trade turned every shell into 8 shells. Finally, she donated 7287 shells to a school science project. How many shells did Amara have left after the donation?

In the morning, a food pantry had 101 boxes of pasta on the shelf. By midday, a grocery donation added 78 more boxes. In the afternoon, a school food drive added 32 more boxes. The pantry director mentioned that 20 extra grocery bags were also donated, though that had nothing to do with the pasta box count. That evening, 106 boxes were distributed to families in need. Right before closing, a late donation added 12 more boxes. How many boxes of pasta were on the shelf after the late donation?

In the morning, a national mint had 221 rolls of coins ready for production. By midday, a bulk order turned every roll into 8 rolls, and in the afternoon a second bulk order turned each of those into 9 rolls. The mint supervisor mentioned that 40 extra coin wrappers were also delivered, though that had nothing to do with the roll count. That evening, a third bulk order turned every roll into 9 rolls, and a massive shipment of 137692 rolls was then sent to regional banks. Right after, the remaining rolls tripled when a special commemorative batch was added, and before the night ended, 4460 rolls were sent to an overseas partner. How many rolls of coins were left after the overseas shipment?

In the morning, a fish market had 218 crates of shrimp delivered. By midday, a second delivery added 58 more crates. In the afternoon, the crates were split evenly between 2 storage rooms, and only one room's stock was tracked. That evening, a wholesale order turned every crate into 6 crates, a deal that took '180 minutes, or three hours' to finalize. Right before closing, a final bulk order turned every crate into 2 crates. How many crates of shrimp were in that storage room after the final bulk order?

A toy library had 133 board games available at the start of the year. A donation added 47 more games, and a second donation brought in 15 more. A local school contributed 20 more games. The librarian mentioned a dozen new game shelves had also been installed, though that had nothing to do with the game count. A big weekend event then required lending out 207 games. A late return brought back 65 games, but 15 games were then retired due to missing pieces. How many board games did the toy library have after retiring those games?

Diego had 141 trading cards in his binder, while his rival Beckham had 90 cards in his. A convention trade turned every card Diego had into 9 cards. He then received 61 more cards as a birthday gift. A bonus round turned every card into 2 cards, a round that took '60 minutes, or one hour' to finish. A second bonus round turned every card into 2 cards again. Finally, he traded away 4583 cards for a single legendary card he wanted. How many cards did Diego have left after that trade?

In the morning, a toy store had 198 puzzle boxes in stock. By midday, a delivery added 14 more boxes. In the afternoon, half of the boxes were sent to a sister store, and only the remaining half stayed on the shelf. The manager mentioned that 25 extra puzzle mats were also delivered, though that had nothing to do with the box count. That evening, 3 more boxes arrived from a late shipment. Right before closing, 49 boxes were sold during a big sale. A final bulk order turned every remaining box into 6 boxes. How many puzzle boxes were there after the final bulk order?

In the morning, a bakery had 224 muffins ready for sale. By midday, a catering order added 33 more muffins. In the afternoon, the muffin count doubled when a wholesale client placed a matching order. That evening, 154 muffins were sold during a rush. Right after, a final bulk order turned every muffin into 3 muffins. Before closing, 8 more muffins were added from a last batch. How many muffins were there after the last batch was added?

Zoey had 226 charm beads in her jewelry box, while her friend Harlow had 100 beads in hers. A bead-multiplying trade turned every bead Zoey had into 4 beads. She then used 229 beads to make bracelets for her whole class. A second trade turned every remaining bead into 7 beads. A final trade turned every bead into 3 beads. How many beads did Zoey have after the final trade?

Mateo had 156 toy trucks in his collection, while his friend Enzo had 90 trucks in his. Mateo received 19 more trucks for his birthday. He then bought 30 more trucks with saved allowance. A garage sale added 68 more trucks, a haul that took '180 minutes, or three hours' to sort. He then split his trucks evenly into 3 storage bins and kept only one bin. A final trade turned every truck in that bin into 2 trucks. How many toy trucks did Mateo have in that bin after the final trade?

In the morning, Nora had 222 friendship beads in a jar, while her friend Skye had 100 beads in hers. By midday, a bead-multiplying trade turned every bead into 7 beads. In the afternoon, a second trade turned every bead into 2 beads. That evening, a third trade turned every bead into 5 beads. Right after, the beads were split evenly into 4 jars, and only one jar's beads were tracked. Before the night ended, 455 beads from that jar were used to make a large necklace. How many beads were left in that jar after making the necklace?

A school had 40 basketballs in the equipment room at the start of the season. The gym teacher checked out 23 basketballs for the varsity team. Then 4 more were checked out for the junior varsity team. During a rainy week, 5 more balls were sent to the middle school gym, a loan that took '60 minutes, or one hour' to arrange. Finally, 7 more balls were sent to an after-school program. A donation drive then turned every remaining basketball into 7 basketballs. How many basketballs were in the equipment room after the donation drive?

In the morning, a print shop had 221 flyers ready for a school fundraiser. By midday, a bulk order turned every flyer into 8 flyers, and in the afternoon 9 more flyers were added from a test print. That evening, a second bulk order turned every flyer into 9 flyers. Right after, 49 more flyers arrived from a late print run. Before closing, the flyers were split evenly between 2 delivery vans, and only one van's load was tracked. A final rush order turned every flyer in that van into 8 flyers. How many flyers were in that van after the final rush order?

A warehouse had 209 boxes of tiles delivered for a renovation project. A quality check removed 20 damaged boxes. A second delivery brought in 24 more boxes. A third delivery added 27 more boxes, arriving after a drive that took '180 minutes, or three hours.' The boxes were then split evenly into 3 job sites, and only one site's supply was tracked. A final bulk order turned every box at that site into 6 boxes. How many boxes of tiles were at that site after the final bulk order?

In the morning, a toy store had 206 action figures in stock. By midday, 42 figures were sold to early shoppers. In the afternoon, a bulk delivery turned every figure into 2 figures. That evening, a second bulk delivery turned every figure into 2 figures again, a shipment that took '120 minutes, or two hours' to unload. Right before closing, 589 figures were sold during a big holiday sale. How many action figures were left after the holiday sale?
